command: lake env leanchecker <module>, once per module, sequentially
note: leanchecker treats its argument as a module-name prefix, so `leanchecker Sarkozy` replays all 114 Sarkozy.* modules concurrently in one process; it reached 114 GB and was stopped by earlyoom (exit 143). Each of those modules passed when replayed on its own, and the aggregate module Sarkozy itself declares no constants (aggregate-module-constants.log), so every declaration of the project was replayed.
